== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Yarech is a former noble who possesses the ability to use a [[Pattern]] to delay his own death. His physical appearance is heavily scarred, characterized by numerous stitches and bandages that give him the appearance of a flesh-based patchwork [[construct]]. These injuries are the result of being torn apart by [[Tanakite Worldweavers]], though he continues to endure significant physical trauma, including being struck by arrows and blades. In combat, Yarech utilizes a war-hammer to defend himself and his companions. Despite his severe injuries, he is capable of surviving heavy impacts by leaping great distances. He is depicted as a vocal participant in his group's struggles, expressing frustration regarding the lack of heroic action and the potential futility of certain missions.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Yarech's physical form is held together by heavy stitching and tape. This condition resulted from being previously torn apart by the [[Tanakite Worldweavers]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|He utilizes [[Worldweaving]] techniques and possesses a [[Pattern]] of suspended death. This specific power allows him to indefinitely postpone injury and destruction, which he also uses to suspend a diamond-headed war-hammer.}}

== Threshold: Stories from Cradle ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Having been previously torn apart by the [[Tanakite Worldweavers]], Yarech's body is now heavily held together with tape and stitches. He utilizes [[Worldweaving]] techniques to maintain a [[Pattern]] of suspended death, which allows him to indefinitely postpone any injury or destruction. Through this specialized [[Pattern]], he is also able to keep a diamond-headed war-hammer suspended.}}
